{{EmoteInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:Revenge.png]] |-|Animation = [[File:RevengeAnimated.gif]] |cost = Meme Emotes [[Gamepasses|Gamepass]] ({{Robux|55}}) |creator = ''R15'' - Shapic2
''R6'' - mattgrant |rarity = {{Color|Common}} |looped = Yes |moveable = No |music = Yes |interactable = No |oldmusic = '''Version 1 Music''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Revenge (Original)|thumb|center|250px]] |newmusic = '''Version 2 Music''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Revenge|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Creeper, aw man...|Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ == Description == '''Revenge''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that is bundled with the Meme Emotes gamepass which can be bought for {{Robux|55}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/1031577/profile mattgrant]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} Revenge.gif|First version (19 July 2019 – 29 October 2020) }} ==Trivia== *This [[Emotes|emote]] was based on a music video called [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cPJUBQd-PNM Revenge], hence the name. **The store description for this emote is the first few lines in the song. ***The shades on the '''Revenge''' emote icon are also a reference to the music video. **The version 1 music was a reference to ''Minecraft'', as it was a Noteblock playing the Revenge theme. **The version 2 music is a Wii Shop remixed version of the Revenge. *'''Revenge''' was one of the first emotes to be added to the game. *Although shades can be seen on the emote icon of '''Revenge''', you do not acquire those shades while performing the emote. ==Update History== *'''19 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.0]] **'''Revenge''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. **Music replaced. **Now obtained from the Meme Emotes gamepass ({{Robux|200}}) instead of costing {{Robux|150}}. *'''22 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]]e **Music removed. *'''7 June 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]]c **Music re-added. *'''24 February 2024''' - [[v1.14.0]] **Cost decreased from {{Robux|200}} to {{Robux|100}}. *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **Cost decreased from {{Robux|100}} to {{Robux|70}}. *'''2 August 2026''' - [[v2.4.0|v2.4.2a]] **Cost decreased from {{Robux|70}} to {{Robux|55}}. {{EmoteNavBox}}
